notes.title: Optimizations and Italian - V1.0.0.4 Patch Note
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Big thanks to everyone who supports Lucky Hero and gives us feedback. We noticed while many of you are enjoying the game, there are still some issues and the pacing being too slow is often mentioned. Rest assured we are working very hard to improve the game experience further!

Here is the latest patch:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44208403/9472854a557a7736e66d50445088d6f796143828.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Now you can check a new window during the battle - Symbol Store Item Preview. It allows you to see what the store offers without opening the store
[*] Adjusted the difficulty for some enemies
[*] Adjusted the icon of Venomous Armor
[*] Support Italian now, credit to Daniele "Bollazza" Bolis
[*] Some bug fixes
[/list]

We are very lucky to have Daniele "Bollazza" Bolis, an enthusiastic member of the game’s community, to translate Lucky Hero into Italian. Hope Italian players will enjoy the game better!

notes.title: TEST YOUR LUCK NOW! LUCKY HERO IS NOW AVAILABLE ON STEAM!
notes.content:
Hello Heroes!

The unique roguelike deckbuilder [b]Lucky Hero is now available on Steam! Enjoy a 10% discount for the first few days.[/b]

After a long period of demo playtest, the full version now has added new features including two new characters - Assassin and Summoner, which provide possibilities for new builds and different experiences.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Instead of cards, symbols will appear on the Wheel of Fortune to be played by you.
[*] Utilizing positional relationships between symbols, you should strategically plan your moves considering methods of changing positions.
[*] Three very different characters provide unique experiences.
[*] It is great fun pondering how to tactically choose symbols and defeat various enemies.
[*] Cute pixel art and animations.
[/list]

[b]Join our Discord[/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/sBRr2ytXR2]Discord[/url]

notes.title: The Latest Demo is LIVE!
notes.content:
Dear Players:

We are thrilled to meet with you all at the Steam Next Festival! "Lucky Hero" will be updating a demo on October 9th for you , providing you with an exciting sneak peek! ! This demo will showcase part of the content within the game. The aim is to let you understand the specific game mechanics and appreciate its charm. We also look forward to hearing your feedback to help improve the game.

If you find any issues with the monster strength or character symbols in terms of their setup, do not hesitate to let us know.

[h2][b]Introduction of "Lucky Hero": [/b][/h2]
"Lucky Hero" is a Symbol-building Roguelike game developed by Mora Churrasco Studio. The overall game experience is somewhat similar to traditional card-building Roguelike games, yet it notably stands out with its deluge of innovative systems.
[list]
[*] Weapons and Gear have been transformed into symbols on a wheel, with certain spatial relationships existing between symbolsMastering these relationships is fundamental to unlocking the symbols' full potential.
[*] An in-game store system allows you to purchase symbols during battles. This means defeating enemies is not the only purpose of each battle. Accumulating gold and continually strengthening yourself through the symbol shop for future formidable enemies is also a crucial part of the game.
[*] The game has a variety of active and passive skills that can produce unexpected interesting effects when combined with symbols.
[*] Powerful enemies have abundant ways to interfere with the player. Be mindful to clean up your symbols in time!
[/list]

[h2][b]About Full Version:[/b][/h2]
The final version of the game will have 3 complete characters, over 300 types of symbols, and even more varieties of monsters and bosses. There will also be additional advanced difficulty levels available.

[h2][b]Where can I post my feedback?[/b][/h2]
We wholeheartedly welcome your feedback on our game via our Discord. Hearing your impressions and thoughts truly means a lot to us.

[url=https://discord.gg/sBRr2ytXR2]Discord[/url]
